comparison.objective: Switch a furnace variac on at zero and gradually ramp it to 60 V, rather than tune a shock absorber from impact response.
comparison.physical_skill: Rocker actuation, analogue-dial reading, long-range knob rotation, and regrasping versus recessed hex work, collar rotation, relocking, and guarded mechanical cycling.
comparison.success_condition: Power-on at 0 V, ramp no faster than 10 V/s, finish at 60 V without exceeding 65 V versus two bounded physical stop cycles.
comparison.reason: Both involve rotary adjustment and regrasping, but the variac tests visual setpoint tracking and rate control; it has no fastener, moving socket, contact dynamics, or response iteration. No spec versions exist.
